mainEntity.name: What kind of local search optimization is included in GEO services for accountants?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local search optimization for accountants typically includes several key strategies. This involves optimizing your Google Business Profile with accurate information, relevant services, and customer reviews. It also includes on-page SEO for your website, ensuring your service pages target specific local keywords, and building local citations (listings on online directories). Content creation focused on local topics and local link building are also crucial components to signal relevance to search engines for your target geographic areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Local search optimization for accountants involves Google Business Profile optimization, local keyword targeting on your website, building local citations, and creating location-specific content.
